_note: Audio catalog. slots[kind.name] = { active: variantId, variants: { variantId: { file, src, note } } }. Files live at audio/<kind>/<name>__<variant>.mp3. Import a family: drop files named <kind>/<name>__<variant>.mp3 (or <kind>.<name>__<variant>.mp3 flat) into audio/_import/ and POST /api/author/audio-import — they are moved into place and registered here. The editor's Audio panel switches `active`. slot.active may also be "random" or "a,b,c" (one picked per play); a variant may carry "level" (gain multiplier).
